sources.snippet: Established in 2025, the FinAI-Lab (Financial AI Laboratory) is a joint scientific research laboratory founded by BNP Paribas and Télécom Paris (a member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris and the Institut Mines Telecom), dedicated to the study and development of artificial intelligence applied to banking and finance.
